programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: Yuko Awakens! For Family Reasons You're Now a Demon Girl
programme.desc: Following a strange dream, Yuko Yoshida wakes up to find she has grown demon horns and a tail; her mother Seiko reveals that their family are the descendants of a dark clan who live in poverty because of the opposing light clan.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: Just How Sporty Are You!? Everything Is Fluctuating
programme.desc: Yuko challenges Momo to a battle during the weekend, which ends up turning into an all-day running session; another demon girl prepares to set Yuko back on the right path.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: Nightmare or Forebear?! The Doorstop of Darkness Descends
programme.desc: Yuko's demon ancestor Lilith appears in her dream to give her some advice, only for her to forget everything she said when she wakes up.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: Sharpen Your Mind!! The Newly Awakened Powers of the Magical Girl
programme.desc: Momo discovers a switch on the bottom of the statue that Yuko carries around; upon being flipped, it gives Lilith the opportunity to possess Yuko's body.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: A Town Full of Traps?? The Demon on the Brink Awakens a New Ability
programme.desc: Yuko buys a camera with the money she was going to use to pay off her debt.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: Courage to Face the Future!! The Heavy Roller Won't Stop
programme.desc: Lilith sends Yuko into Momo's subconscious, where she ends up tidying the dark muck surrounding her dreams.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: The Pink Method!! The Wheel of Fate is a Round Tire!!
programme.desc: The Yoshida family celebrate by holding an okonomiyaki party after discovering that Yuko's actions have lifted the curse limiting their family to a tight monthly budget.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: The Cursed Fruit!! Beware the Sour Mikan!!
programme.desc: The magical girl, Mikan Hinatsuki, is called by Momo to assist her with Yuko's training; Yuko learns that magical girls disappear if they use up all of their magic.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: Final Exams!! Today I'm One of Those Brainy Demons!!
programme.desc: Wanting Momo to take her more seriously, Yuko proposes a friendly duel to determine who can score best on history during the final exams.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: The Ancestor Evolves!! A Pair of Glasses Reflect Within a Dark Lab
programme.desc: Yuko's occult-obsessed classmate, Sion Ogura, brings her and Momo to the Black Magic Studies Lab to try some experiments on Lilith's statue.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: Diving into Dreams Once Again!! Break Through the Pink Defense Line
programme.desc: Wanting to get Momo to open up to her, Yuko once again dives into her dream; this time she has to break through her outer defenses.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door
programme.sub-title: Feelings to Convey!! A New Leap Forward for Demonkind!!
programme.desc: Chasing after Momo after she runs off, Yuko proposes that she quit being a magical girl and become her vassal so she can search for Sakura.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: Yet Another Showdown! The Magical Girl has a Brand New Appearance?!
programme.desc: Challenging an archnemesis to a duel can be awkward if they mistake it as an invitation to hang out.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: Urban Exploration! The Troubled Mikan and the Excited Demon
programme.desc: Mikan recognizes the box that seals Shamiko's dad; the factory ruins on the outskirts of town may hold clues about Momo's sister.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: The Dark Witch Returns! With Steam From Hell!
programme.desc: After hearing that Lilith has been sealed away for over 2000 years, Shamiko and Momo come up with a plan to let her borrow Shamiko's body and enjoy a day of freedom.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: A New Species Discovered! The Town Cafe Is a Demon Lair!
programme.desc: Shamiko visits a cafe rumored to be frequented by demons in search of clues about Sakura; Shamiko ends up getting a part-time job.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: Raid! The Pink Plan to Retake Shamiko!
programme.desc: Shamiko learns that Lico and Shirosawa have a connection to Sakura and decides to continue working part-time at the cafe; Momo is vehemently opposed to Shamiko's job.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: Vow Under the Setting Sun! The Path Forward for Demonkind!
programme.desc: When Shamiko finds herself in trouble, the one who saves her is none other than Sakura Chiyoda; Momo takes action to save Shamiko from her nightmare.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: A Short Break!! The Demonic Summer Festival
programme.desc: Shamiko's summer vacation has turned out to be hectic; she tries to reclaim some peace in her life, but the looming stack of homework casts a dark shadow.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: Sparks Fly?! Light and Dark Go on a Joint Excursion!
programme.desc: Shamiko promises to visit the zoo with Momo and Mikan and tries making boxed lunches for them; Shamiko needs help to make something tasty, so she visits a certain address.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: Pitch Black Feelings!! Darkness Peach Returns!!
programme.desc: Momo is stuck in her darkness form; without the ability to control her strength, Momo unintentionally destroys everything she touches.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: The Ancestor's Dojo?! Demonkind's Ultimate Weapon
programme.desc: Shamiko can't use her magic rod right because of a lack of imagination; she undergoes special training in Lilith's sealed space.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: New Semester! The Magical Girl's New Duty!
programme.desc: A chaotic summer break ends and a new school semester begins; Mikan transfers into Shamiko's class.

programme.title: The Demon Girl Next Door 2
programme.sub-title: A Ritual in Darkness! The Demon's New Ally!!
programme.desc: Shamiko and Momo enter Mikan's heart to negotiate with Ugallu, the entity responsible for the magical girl's curse.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Hercules, a Greek demigod, is haunted by his past as he leads a band of mercenaries. One day, the king of Thrace seeks his help in protecting his kingdom from a tyrannical warlord.

programme.title: GoldenEye
programme.desc: Agent 007, along with Natalia Simonav, travels to Russia to locate the satellite nuclear weapon stolen by Alec, a former agent, who Bond believed was dead.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen leads a lonely life and is bullied by his peers at school. He happily befriends Abby, his new helpful neighbour, without being aware that she is hiding a secret from him.

programme.title: Crime Spree
programme.desc: A group of French thieves is tasked with stealing an expensive necklace from a home in Chicago. However, the robbery turns into a fiasco when they realize that the house belongs to a mafia kingpin.

programme.title: DSC
programme.desc: Talented directors provide an entertaining insight into the most intriguing stories and anecdotes concerning some of their best works.

programme.title: The Circus
programme.desc: The Tramp is hired by the proprietor of a circus after he stumbles into the middle of a performance and becomes the star attraction. He ends up falling in love with a horse rider.

programme.title: Non-Stop
programme.desc: A US air marshal receives threatening messages demanding that his airline transfer USD 150 million dollars to an offshore account, in the absence of which the passengers of his flight will be killed.

programme.title: Modern Times
programme.desc: A factory production line worker is thrown out on the street for his manic behaviour. He then meets a young, homeless girl, who is recently orphaned, and tries to build a home with her.

programme.title: Incoming
programme.desc: Imprisoned at the International Space Station, a group of terrorists manage to escape confinement and take control of the ship. However, their mission to target the Soviets threatens world peace.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: After Paris, a Trojan prince, has an affair with Menelaus's wife, Helen, he decides to take her with him. Later, Menelaus's brother uses that as an excuse to wage a war against the city of Troy.

programme.title: The Pink Panther
programme.desc: A bumbling Inspector Clouseau is tasked with solving the French football coach's murder and the theft of the Pink Panther, a priceless diamond from his ring.

programme.title: Piranha 3D
programme.desc: An earthquake cracks open the bottom of a lake, releasing a prehistoric species of piranha. As sinister events unfold due to the flesh-eating fish, a group of strangers team up to stop the bloodbath.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Steppenwolf and his Parademons return after aeons to destroy Earth. However, Batman seeks the help of Wonder Woman to recruit The Flash, Cyborg and Aquaman to fight their new powerful enemy.

programme.title: Hansel & Gretel: Witch Hunters
programme.desc: Brother-sister duo Hansel and Gretel are professional witch hunters who help innocent villagers. But they soon stumble upon a case that could hold the key to their past.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: Sam and Mikaela once again join forces with Optimus Prime and the Autobots to save Earth from The Fallen, the ruthless robot who teams up with the Decepticons.

programme.title: Casino Royale
programme.desc: James Bond, the renowned secret agent, must prevent Le Chiffre, an evil banker, from winning a high-stakes poker game. However, things get complicated when he enters the tournament himself.
